name: What is considered a primary suite addition?

mainEntity.name: What is considered a primary suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A primary suite addition typically involves expanding an existing home to create a new, dedicated space for the homeowners' main bedroom. This can include adding a larger bedroom area, an en-suite bathroom, and often a walk-in closet. The goal is to provide a private and luxurious retreat within the home, increasing both living space and property value. These additions can be built as a bump-out on the first floor or as a second-story extension, depending on lot size, zoning regulations, and structural feasibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: A primary suite addition creates a new, dedicated main bedroom space within a home, often including an en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet.
